item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Eating. Food is fuel, and most of the choices that matter happen before you're hungry. Decide your next meal now, not when you're starving. Build it around protein and something green, and drink water first. Notice if you're eating from stress or habit rather than hunger. You've got plenty of pauses scheduled today, so use one before you eat. Your action: plan your next meal right now, and write it down.
